mapper.sql:
SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.name AS goodsName, g.spec AS spec, g.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, u.name AS unitName, g.is_weighed AS isWeighed, CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN 'OUT' ELSE 'WARNING' END AS suggestType, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS quantity, g.safety_stock_lower AS safetyStockLower,
-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ir.change_qty) FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.goods_id = g.id AND ir.record_type = 'SALE_OUT' AND ir.operate_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)), 0) AS soldQty,
CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS avgDailySales, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(poi.quantity - poi.received_qty) FROM purchase_order_item poi JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = poi.order_id WHERE poi.goods_id = g.id AND po.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL')), 0) AS onWayQty,
CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS leadTimeDays,
CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS suggestQty,
CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS calcBasis, (SELECT sg.supplier_id FROM supplier_goods sg WHERE sg.goods_id = g.id ORDER BY sg.is_default DESC, sg.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS supplierId,
CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS supplierName, (SELECT sg.supply_price FROM supplier_goods sg WHERE sg.goods_id = g.id ORDER BY sg.is_default DESC, sg.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS supplyPrice, (SELECT roi.received_price FROM receipt_order_item roi JOIN receipt_order ro ON ro.id = roi.receipt_id WHERE roi.goods_id = g.id ORDER BY ro.receipt_time DESC, roi.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastPurchasePrice FROM goods g JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = g.unit_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id
mapper.select:
g.status = 1
AND g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND g.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsCode}, '%')
AND g.category_id IN #{cid}
AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0
AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower
AND (COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0 OR (COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower))
ORDER BY COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) ASC, g.id DESC
